# GxBake command line reference

<!-- Generated by `python -m gxbake.clidoc` from gxbake/cli.py. Do not edit by hand. -->

Every command the `gxbake` executable (or `python -m gxbake`) accepts. Run with no
command, or with file paths, it opens the desktop app instead. For how the commands
fit together when porting a game, see [the porting workflow](workflow.md).

Sizes such as `448K`, `1.5M` or `6MiB` are accepted wherever an option takes a size.
Commands that check something exit with 1 when the check fails, so they can gate a
build or CI job.

## Commands

| Command | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| [`convert`](#gxbake-convert) | convert files or folders |
| [`inspect`](#gxbake-inspect) | print what GxBake sees in a file or folder |
| [`rs`](#gxbake-rs) | list the NPCs and models in a RuneScape cache |
| [`ff7`](#gxbake-ff7) | look inside Final Fantasy VII field models (.hrc, .p, .a, .tex) |
| [`ffxi`](#gxbake-ffxi) | look inside Final Fantasy XI DATs, sounds and file tables |
| [`validate`](#gxbake-validate) | check a staged gamedir like the disc builder does |
| [`budget`](#gxbake-budget) | per-map memory report against the GameCube port's windows |
| [`fit`](#gxbake-fit) | trim a .gct's top mips until it fits the world texture budget |
| [`sfx`](#gxbake-sfx) | shrink WAVs under the port's per-file sound cap (20 KiB gameplay, 48 KiB menu) |
| [`disc`](#gxbake-disc) | disc usage: sector cost, duplicate files and textures, files no map names |
| [`extract`](#gxbake-extract) | unpack a Quake/GoldSrc .pak, Source .vpk or .pk3 archive |
| [`slim`](#gxbake-slim) | show where a studio model's bytes go and thin its animation |
| [`sky`](#gxbake-sky) | turn a panorama, cubemap cross/strip, photo or six faces into the port's sky sides |
| [`pack`](#gxbake-pack) | list, extract, build and edit .gct texture packs |
| [`gui`](#gxbake-gui) | open the desktop app |

## `gxbake convert`

Convert files or folders.

```
gxbake convert paths [paths ...] --output OUTPUT [--max-edge MAX_EDGE] [--no-mipmaps] [--alpha
    {auto,on,off}] [--no-pack] [--pack-name PACK_NAME] [--raw-cmp] [--mdl-max-edge MDL_MAX_EDGE]
    [--mdl-anim-step MDL_ANIM_STEP] [--spr-scale SPR_SCALE] [--model-scale MODEL_SCALE] [--model-up
    {y,z}] [--model-skin-max-edge MODEL_SKIN_MAX_EDGE] [--no-model-full] [--model-static]
    [--model-fps MODEL_FPS] [--no-model-clips] [--no-blend-bones] [--rose-scale ROSE_SCALE]
    [--rose-yaw ROSE_YAW] [--rose-entry ROSE_ENTRY] [--rs-scale RS_SCALE] [--rs-yaw RS_YAW]
    [--rs-entry KIND:ID] [--ffxi-scale FFXI_SCALE] [--ffxi-yaw FFXI_YAW] [--ffxi-skeleton DAT]
    [--ffxi-music-wav] [--ff7-scale FF7_SCALE] [--ff7-yaw FF7_YAW] [--video-width VIDEO_WIDTH]
    [--video-height VIDEO_HEIGHT] [--video-fps VIDEO_FPS] [--fit-world] [--wt-pool WT_POOL]
    [--wad-dir WAD_DIR] [--cache CACHE] [--no-sky-detect] [--sky-yaw SKY_YAW] [--sky-fov SKY_FOV]
    [--sky-exposure SKY_EXPOSURE]
```

| Argument | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `paths` … |  | files or folders (a gamedir, WADs, BSPs, models, images, audio, video) |
| `-o OUTPUT`, `--output OUTPUT` |  | **Required.** staged output folder |
| `--max-edge MAX_EDGE` | `256` | largest texture side for loose images (power of two) |
| `--no-mipmaps` |  | write level 0 only |
| `--alpha {auto,on,off}` | `auto` | CMPR 1-bit alpha: auto uses it when the image has transparency |
| `--no-pack` |  | one .gct per loose image |
| `--pack-name PACK_NAME` | `textures` | loose images go to media/<name>.gct |
| `--raw-cmp` |  | also write media/<name>.cmp (level 0) per loose image |
| `--mdl-max-edge MDL_MAX_EDGE` | `64` | largest skin side in gc_studio/<name>t.mdl |
| `--mdl-anim-step MDL_ANIM_STEP` | `1` | keep every Nth animation frame in gc_studio/<name>.mdl (seqgroup 0 only) |
| `--spr-scale SPR_SCALE` | `2` | sprite downscale factor |
| `--model-scale MODEL_SCALE` | `1.0` | 3D model import: source units → GoldSrc units |
| `--model-up {y,z}` | `y` | 3D model import: source up axis |
| `--model-skin-max-edge MODEL_SKIN_MAX_EDGE` | `256` | 3D model import: largest skin side in models/<name>.mdl |
| `--no-model-full` |  | skip models/<name>.mdl for imported 3D models |
| `--model-static` |  | 3D model import: ignore skeletons and animations |
| `--model-fps MODEL_FPS` | `15` | 3D model import: animation sample rate |
| `--no-model-clips` |  | don't merge <name>@<clip>.<ext> animation files |
| `--no-blend-bones` |  | Source models: snap blended vertices to one bone instead of adding helper bones |
| `--rose-scale ROSE_SCALE` | `39.37` | ROSE Online models: GoldSrc units per metre |
| `--rose-yaw ROSE_YAW` | `90.0` | ROSE Online models: degrees to turn about Z (90 faces them +X) |
| `--rose-entry ROSE_ENTRY` |  | ROSE .zsc/.chr: convert only this object/character index (repeatable; default all) |
| `--rs-scale RS_SCALE` | `0.35` | RuneScape caches: GoldSrc units per model unit (128 units = one tile) |
| `--rs-yaw RS_YAW` |  | RuneScape caches: extra degrees to turn about Z |
| `--rs-entry KIND:ID` |  | RuneScape caches: convert npc:<id> or model:<id> (repeatable; default every named NPC) |
| `--ffxi-scale FFXI_SCALE` | `39.37` | Final Fantasy XI models: GoldSrc units per FFXI unit |
| `--ffxi-yaw FFXI_YAW` |  | Final Fantasy XI models: extra degrees to turn about Z |
| `--ffxi-skeleton DAT` |  | Final Fantasy XI: race skeleton DAT for equipment and face DATs that have none of their own |
| `--ffxi-music-wav` |  | Final Fantasy XI: write .bgw music as WAVs under sound/ffxi/ instead of media/<name>.gcpcm |
| `--ff7-scale FF7_SCALE` | `2.5` | Final Fantasy VII field models: GoldSrc units per FF7 unit |
| `--ff7-yaw FF7_YAW` |  | Final Fantasy VII field models: extra degrees to turn about Z |
| `--video-width VIDEO_WIDTH` | `320` | GCVID frame width |
| `--video-height VIDEO_HEIGHT` | `240` | GCVID frame height |
| `--video-fps VIDEO_FPS` | `15` | GCVID frame rate |
| `--fit-world` |  | trim world texture packs' top mips until they fit the engine's MEM1 pool |
| `--wt-pool WT_POOL` | `448K` | pool size for --fit-world |
| `--wad-dir WAD_DIR` |  | extra WAD search folder (repeatable) |
| `--cache CACHE` |  | CMPR encode cache folder |
| `--no-sky-detect` |  | keep big 2:1 images, crosses, strips and .hdr files as textures instead of making skies of them |
| `--sky-yaw SKY_YAW` | `270.0` | panorama skies: engine yaw the image centre faces (0 rt, 90 bk, 180 lf, 270 ft) |
| `--sky-fov SKY_FOV` | `180.0` | flat photos as skies: horizontal degrees the photo covers |
| `--sky-exposure SKY_EXPOSURE` |  | .hdr panoramas: stops brighter (+) or darker (-) than auto |

## `gxbake inspect`

Print what GxBake sees in a file or folder.

```
gxbake inspect path
```

| Argument | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `path` |  | file or folder |

## `gxbake rs`

List the NPCs and models in a RuneScape cache.

```
gxbake rs path [--find FIND] [--all] [--limit LIMIT] [--json]
```

| Argument | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `path` |  | main_file_cache.dat2 (JS5: OSRS / RS2) or main_file_cache.dat (2004-era), or its folder |
| `--find FIND` |  | only NPCs whose name contains this |
| `--all` |  | include NPCs named `null` (variants the client swaps in) |
| `--limit LIMIT` | `50` | NPCs to print (0 = all) |
| `--json` |  | print everything as JSON |

## `gxbake ff7`

Look inside Final Fantasy VII field models (.hrc, .p, .a, .tex).

```
gxbake ff7 path [--anims] [--json]
```

| Argument | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `path` |  | a skeleton (.hrc), polygon model (.p), animation (.a) or texture (.tex) |
| `--anims` |  | for a .hrc: list the .a files beside it with the same bone count |
| `--json` |  | print as JSON |

## `gxbake ffxi`

Look inside Final Fantasy XI DATs, sounds and file tables.

```
gxbake ffxi path [--id ID] [--textures DIR] [--wav OUT] [--json]
```

| Argument | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `path` |  | a ROM DAT, a .spw/.bgw sound, or the FINAL FANTASY XI folder (with --id) |
| `--id ID` |  | resolve this file id through VTABLE/FTABLE and describe that DAT |
| `--textures DIR` |  | write the DAT's textures as PNGs here |
| `--wav OUT` |  | decode a .spw/.bgw to this WAV |
| `--json` |  | print as JSON |

## `gxbake validate`

Check a staged gamedir like the disc builder does.

```
gxbake validate path
```

| Argument | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `path` |  | staged gamedir |

## `gxbake budget`

Per-map memory report against the GameCube port's windows.

```
gxbake budget path [--map MAP] [--include GLOB] [--json] [--strict] [--verbose] [--pool POOL]
    [--split {64,32,16,8}] [--budget NAME=SIZE]
```

| Argument | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `path` |  | staged gamedir (the output of convert) |
| `--map MAP` |  | only this map (repeatable) |
| `--include GLOB` |  | models every map loads, e.g. `models/v_*.mdl` (repeatable) |
| `--json` |  | print the report as JSON |
| `--strict` |  | exit 1 on warnings too |
| `-v`, `--verbose` |  | list the biggest items on every line |
| `--pool POOL` |  | world texture MEM1 pool (default 448K, GC_WT_POOL_BYTES) |
| `--split {64,32,16,8}` |  | split dimension the pool must manage (default 64; lower accepts softer textures) |
| `--budget NAME=SIZE` |  | override any budget, e.g. studio_arena=1.5M (repeatable) |

## `gxbake fit`

Trim a .gct's top mips until it fits the world texture budget.

```
gxbake fit path [--output OUTPUT] [--max-edge MAX_EDGE] [--pool POOL] [--split {64,32,16,8}]
    [--budget NAME=SIZE]
```

| Argument | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `path` |  | world texture pack (.gct) |
| `-o OUTPUT`, `--output OUTPUT` |  | write the fitted pack here (otherwise a dry run) |
| `--max-edge MAX_EDGE` |  | also cap every texture to this size first |
| `--pool POOL` |  | world texture MEM1 pool (default 448K, GC_WT_POOL_BYTES) |
| `--split {64,32,16,8}` |  | split dimension the pool must manage (default 64; lower accepts softer textures) |
| `--budget NAME=SIZE` |  | override any budget, e.g. studio_arena=1.5M (repeatable) |

## `gxbake sfx`

Shrink WAVs under the port's per-file sound cap (20 KiB gameplay, 48 KiB menu).

```
gxbake sfx paths [paths ...] [--output OUTPUT] [--in-place] [--menu] [--cap CAP] [--min-rate
    MIN_RATE] [--keep-stereo] [--no-8bit] [--truncate] [--verbose]
```

| Argument | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `paths` … |  | .wav files or folders |
| `-o OUTPUT`, `--output OUTPUT` |  | write fitted WAVs here, keeping relative paths |
| `--in-place` |  | overwrite the source files |
| `--menu` |  | use the 48 KiB menu-route cap |
| `--cap CAP` |  | explicit cap, e.g. 16K |
| `--min-rate MIN_RATE` | `11025` | lowest sample rate to fall back to |
| `--keep-stereo` |  | never fold stereo to mono |
| `--no-8bit` |  | never drop to 8-bit samples |
| `--truncate` |  | cut (with a 10 ms fade) what still does not fit |
| `-v`, `--verbose` |  | also list sounds that already fit |

## `gxbake disc`

Disc usage: sector cost, duplicate files and textures, files no map names.

```
gxbake disc path [--include GLOB] [--limit LIMIT] [--json]
```

| Argument | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `path` |  | staged gamedir |
| `--include GLOB` |  | count these as referenced (repeatable) |
| `--limit LIMIT` | `15` | rows per section |
| `--json` |  | print the report as JSON |

## `gxbake extract`

Unpack a Quake/GoldSrc .pak, Source .vpk or .pk3 archive.

```
gxbake extract archives [archives ...] --output OUTPUT [--match MATCH]
```

| Argument | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `archives` … |  | .pak, .vpk or .pk3 files |
| `-o OUTPUT`, `--output OUTPUT` |  | **Required.** folder to extract into |
| `--match MATCH` |  | only members matching this glob, e.g. `models/*` (repeatable) |

## `gxbake slim`

Show where a studio model's bytes go and thin its animation.

```
gxbake slim path [--output OUTPUT] [--step STEP] [--stub PATTERN] [--keep PATTERN]
```

| Argument | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `path` |  | GoldSrc studio model (.mdl) |
| `-o OUTPUT`, `--output OUTPUT` |  | write the slimmed model here (otherwise a dry run) |
| `--step STEP` | `1` | keep every Nth animation frame (fps adjusted, same duration) |
| `--stub PATTERN` |  | reduce matching sequences to one frame (repeatable) |
| `--keep PATTERN` |  | never touch matching sequences (repeatable) |

## `gxbake sky`

Turn a panorama, cubemap cross/strip, photo or six faces into the port's sky sides.

```
gxbake sky inputs [inputs ...] --output OUTPUT [--name NAME] [--layout
    {auto,equirect,cross,strip,faces,photo}] [--yaw YAW] [--fov FOV] [--exposure EXPOSURE] [--size
    SIZE] [--env SIZE] [--preview PNG]
```

| Argument | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `inputs` … |  | one image (equirectangular panorama, .hdr, 4:3/3:4 cross, 6:1 strip or a photo), six face images, or a folder holding them |
| `-o OUTPUT`, `--output OUTPUT` |  | **Required.** staged gamedir; sides go to media/sky_<name><side>.cmp |
| `--name NAME` |  | sky name (worldspawn "skyname"); default from the file name |
| `--layout {auto,equirect,cross,strip,faces,photo}` | `auto` | how to read the input; auto guesses from its shape |
| `--yaw YAW` | `270.0` | engine yaw the image centre (or the cross's front) faces: 0 rt, 90 bk, 180 lf, 270 ft |
| `--fov FOV` | `180.0` | photo layout: horizontal degrees the photo covers; mirrored copies fill the rest |
| `--exposure EXPOSURE` |  | .hdr input: stops brighter (+) or darker (-) than auto |
| `--size SIZE` | `128` | side size; the port loads only 128 |
| `--env SIZE` |  | also write gfx/env/<name><side>.tga at SIZE (PC builds, the disc builder) |
| `--preview PNG` |  | write the decoded sides as a cross to check seams and orientation |

## `gxbake pack`

Manage GCWT texture packs (.gct) directly. Entry names are the image file names, lowercased and cut to 15 characters; the engine reads at most 512 entries per pack.

```
gxbake pack action ...
```

### `gxbake pack list`

The textures in a pack with their sizes.

```
gxbake pack list pack [--name GLOB] [--sort {pack,size}] [--json]
```

| Argument | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `pack` |  | .gct file |
| `--name GLOB` |  | only matching names (repeatable) |
| `--sort {pack,size}` | `pack` | pack order or largest first |
| `--json` |  | print the list as JSON |

### `gxbake pack extract`

Decode textures to PNG, as the GameCube samples them.

```
gxbake pack extract pack --output OUTPUT [--name GLOB] [--all-levels]
```

| Argument | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `pack` |  | .gct file |
| `-o OUTPUT`, `--output OUTPUT` |  | **Required.** folder for the PNGs |
| `--name GLOB` |  | only matching names (repeatable) |
| `--all-levels` |  | also write every mip level as <name>_mip<N>.png |

### `gxbake pack build`

Encode images into a new pack.

```
gxbake pack build images [images ...] --output OUTPUT [--max-edge MAX_EDGE] [--no-mipmaps] [--alpha
    {auto,on,off}]
```

| Argument | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `images` … |  | image files or folders |
| `-o OUTPUT`, `--output OUTPUT` |  | **Required.** .gct to write |
| `--max-edge MAX_EDGE` | `256` | largest texture side (power of two) |
| `--no-mipmaps` |  | write level 0 only |
| `--alpha {auto,on,off}` | `auto` | CMPR 1-bit alpha: auto uses it when the image has transparency |

### `gxbake pack add`

Add images to a pack, replacing entries with the same name.

```
gxbake pack add pack images [images ...] [--output OUTPUT] [--max-edge MAX_EDGE] [--no-mipmaps]
    [--alpha {auto,on,off}]
```

| Argument | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `pack` |  | .gct file |
| `images` … |  | image files or folders |
| `-o OUTPUT`, `--output OUTPUT` |  | write here instead of updating the pack in place |
| `--max-edge MAX_EDGE` | `256` | largest texture side (power of two) |
| `--no-mipmaps` |  | write level 0 only |
| `--alpha {auto,on,off}` | `auto` | CMPR 1-bit alpha: auto uses it when the image has transparency |

### `gxbake pack remove`

Drop entries by name.

```
gxbake pack remove pack GLOB [GLOB ...] [--output OUTPUT]
```

| Argument | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `pack` |  | .gct file |
| `GLOB` … |  | names or globs to remove |
| `-o OUTPUT`, `--output OUTPUT` |  | write here instead of updating the pack in place |

### `gxbake pack merge`

Combine packs; a later pack wins on a name clash.

```
gxbake pack merge packs [packs ...] --output OUTPUT
```

| Argument | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `packs` … |  | .gct files, in priority order (last wins) |
| `-o OUTPUT`, `--output OUTPUT` |  | **Required.** .gct to write |

## `gxbake gui`

Open the desktop app.

```
gxbake gui [paths ...]
```

| Argument | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `paths` … |  | files or folders to open |

## Budget names

The limits `budget` and `fit` check, taken from the Xash3D GameCube port. Change any of them with `--budget NAME=SIZE` (repeatable), e.g. `--budget studio_arena=1.5M`.

| Name | Default | What it limits |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `main_ram` | 24.0 MiB (25,165,824 bytes) | GameCube main RAM (MEM1) |
| `aram` | 16.0 MiB (16,777,216 bytes) | auxiliary RAM (ARAM) |
| `disc` | 1.4 GiB (1,459,978,240 bytes) | usable bytes on a GameCube disc |
| `wt_pool` | 448.0 KiB (458,752 bytes) | world texture MEM1 pool: table, resident low mips and hot ring (GC_WT_POOL_BYTES) |
| `wt_min_hot` | 32.0 KiB (32,768 bytes) | smallest hot ring the split rule accepts (GC_WT_MIN_HOT_BYTES) |
| `wt_split` | 64 | split dimension a pack must fit at to count as ok (a number, not a size) |
| `wt_aram` | 6.0 MiB (6,291,456 bytes) | world texture ARAM store (GC_WT_ARAM_BYTES) |
| `wt_max_textures` | 512 | entries per world pack the engine reads (a count) |
| `studio_arena` | 1.0 MiB (1,048,576 bytes) | studio model MEM1 arena per map |
| `sfx_cache` | 128.0 KiB (131,072 bytes) | MEM1 sound cache (GC_SFX_BUDGET_BYTES; 320K on the menu route) |
| `sfx_max_file` | 20.0 KiB (20,480 bytes) | largest WAV PCM the loader accepts (GC_SFX_MAX_FILE_BYTES; 48K on the menu route) |
| `sfx_aram` | 2.0 MiB (2,097,152 bytes) | ARAM sound store |
| `lightmap_atlas` | 800.0 KiB (819,200 bytes) | lightmap atlas |
